lines.en: Arcs of lightning crackle at my feet.
I do not land; my ki carries me.

lines.zh: 头发比刚才更亮，也更硬。
lines.en: My hair is brighter now, and stiffer.
Flagstones split beneath my steps.

lines.zh: 这已经是另一个层次了。
lines.en: This is another level entirely.
The grass bends outward as I pass.
The air rings with every step.
I need not look; my ki tells me.

lines.zh: 安静下来的时候反而可怕。
lines.en: The quiet around me is the frightening part.

lines.zh: 我收着劲，怕伤到旁边的村子。
lines.en: I hold back for the nearby village.

lines.zh: 这一步我走了半寸，其实想走一格。
lines.en: I took an inch. I wanted a block.

lines.zh: 气在我背后拉出一条尾迹。
lines.en: My ki trails behind me.
I am holding myself in check. It is hard.

lines.zh: 现在只要动一下，就会毁掉东西。
lines.en: One wrong move destroys something.

lines.zh: 我听得见每个人的心跳。
lines.en: I can hear every heartbeat.
My hair stands up like blades.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，周围亮了一下。
lines.en: I open my eyes; the air brightens.
This form should not be kept long.
I inhale and the airflow reverses.
I close my hand slowly.
Everything near me vibrates.
I am counting the time left.
The wind stops when it reaches me.

lines.zh: 我怕的不是对手，是自己。
lines.en: What I fear is not the enemy, but myself.
I let out a long breath.
My nails bite into my palm.
Still standing? Not bad.

lines.zh: 我现在说话很慢，是在忍。
lines.en: I speak slowly. I am holding back.

lines.zh: 你听见电弧的声音了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear the arcs?
Keep your eyes down; the glare will sting.

lines.zh: 你的气在我眼里像一条线。
lines.en: Your ki looks like a single thread to me.
I do not intend to reason with you.

lines.zh: 我现在的速度不是你能追的。
lines.en: You cannot match this speed.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛已经变了颜色。
lines.en: My eyes have changed color.
If you have words, make them quick.
That gap is one step for me.
You're shaking; your ki is scrambled.

lines.zh: 我不想用这个力量对人。
lines.en: I do not want to use this on people.
But you are pushing me.

lines.zh: 我低头看你，像看一件小事。
lines.en: I look down at you as at a small thing.
This gold is a warning.
Leave me be.
Those behind you should not have come.

lines.zh: 疼，可超级赛亚人不会倒。
lines.en: It hurts, but a Super Saiyan doesn't fall.
That sharpened me.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口气，全是热气。
lines.en: I exhale, and it is all heat.
The arcs waver, then steady.

lines.zh: 我按住伤口，血被气蒸干。
lines.en: I press the wound; my aura dries the blood.
My hair dims a shade.
I retreat a quarter block.
The pain reaches me slowly.
I have not gone all out.
I cannot be distracted now.
Keep it away. It will scorch.
I do not need to eat like this.
Set it on the stone.

lines.zh: 一口就够，我快没时间了。
lines.en: One bite is enough. My time runs short.

lines.zh: 这东西被我的气烤干了。
lines.en: My aura dried it out.
Do not use that as a bargaining chip.
I swallow. I taste nothing.
Save it for the children.
Get further away, then hand it over.
One touch and you are thrown clear.
My aura wall is not decorative.
Steady. Do not fall into the arcs.
I lift an eyelid.
That is not even wind to me.

lines.zh: 地面被我踩碎了，你也是。
lines.en: The ground broke under me. So would you.
I step back and press my ki down.

lines.zh: 你撞上的是气，不是身体。
lines.en: You struck my ki, not my body.
One block closer and I stop holding back.
Not now.
I fear I would hurt you.
I cannot discuss this in this state.
I turn my head; my ki still crackles.
Wait until I change back.
I have no room for anything else.
My voice caught.
Do not come closer.
I open my fist, slowly.
End this first.
I snatch it out of the air.
When I move, the ground splits.
I crushed one. Apologies.
This cannot withstand my grip.
I cradle it lightly.

lines.zh: 收进兜里，还得记住它在。
lines.en: I pocket it and must remember it is there.
Dust rises around me.
I look, then put it back.
Not mine. I leave it.
There is a new crater on the ground.
I end this in one strike.

lines.zh: 你选了我，也选了这一刻。
lines.en: You chose me, and this moment.
Arcs wrap my hands.
Your armor will not hold.
I want you to back down.
This is the Kamehameha.
The ground sinks under me.
The light in my eyes changed.
Don't say I didn't warn you; brace yourself.
I raise my hand; ki forms a sphere.
This is the last chance.
I hear your breathing.
One step.
I am bearing down.

lines.zh: 这一整片山我都能掀翻。
lines.en: I could uproot this whole hillside.
I raise my ki to the limit.
You look absurdly slow to me.
The arcs are seeking a target.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很轻，几乎停了。
lines.en: My breathing is nearly gone.
Listen — the air is tearing.
I no longer plan to leave survivors.

lines.zh: 你的每一步我都预判了。
lines.en: I have read every step.

lines.zh: 这一击不带怒气，只有力量。
lines.en: This stroke has no anger, only force.
Dodging will not help.
I am waiting for you to say stop.

lines.zh: 你把武器举起来了，很好。
lines.en: You raised your weapon. Good.
Light spreads from my hands.
I hold one breath.
One punch and the cliff falls.
A ki blast plows a trench.

lines.zh: 我的连击你看不清起点。
lines.en: You cannot see where my combo begins.
You are launched a dozen blocks.
I have already caught up.
This one trails lightning.
The Kamehameha drives forward.
I crush your bracer in my grip.
You blocked. Bones creaked.
One hand pins you; the ground cracks.
That blow uproots three trees.
I stop; my ki still burns.
A meteor-fall of blows.
I left you alive.
You should thank me.
That is enough.

lines.zh: 雷从天落下来，砸在我身上。
lines.en: Lightning falls and strikes me.
I have reached this level.
My ki throws up the sand.
The sky darkened for an instant.
I land in a crater three blocks deep.
Clear this area.
I do not want to hurt anyone.
But my patience is short.

lines.zh: 一直以为不需要这个形态。
lines.en: I thought I would not need this form.

lines.zh: 你听见雷声了吗？那是我。
lines.en: Did you hear thunder? That was me.

lines.zh: 我的头发已经烧起来了。
lines.en: My hair has caught the light.
I look up, eyes glowing.

lines.zh: 这力量不属于一个孩子。
lines.en: This power does not belong to a child.
Anything within ten blocks will be hurt.
I pull my ki in a little.
My exhale flattens the grass.
Do not push me further.
I've held this ki back a long time.

lines.zh: 火还没靠近就被气吹散了。
lines.en: The flame is blown apart before it reaches me.

lines.zh: 我砸出一个深坑，站起来了。
lines.en: I make a deep crater and rise.
Water boils away around me.
The blast costs me half a step.
It turns to ash against me.

lines.zh: 咒力穿过气墙，扎在骨头里。
lines.en: Magic pierces the aura and bites bone.
This form is burning me up.

lines.zh: 雷和我身上的电弧撞在一起。
lines.en: Lightning collides with my own arcs.

lines.zh: 这里连光都没有，气也散了。
lines.en: No light here, and my ki disperses.
